"User enters a valid email that is not registered.",

{"id": "TC2", "title": "Test that an invalid email already registered shows the correct message", "type": "negative",

"User enters a valid name.",
"User enters an already registered email.",
"User enters a valid password.",
"User clicks the 'Register' button."],
"expected_result": "Page shows 'Email already registered'.",
"covers": ["AC2"]},
{"id": "TC3", "title": "Test that a user under 18 years old cannot register", "type": "negative",
"preconditions": "User is on the registration page and has a valid name and password, but is under 18 years old.",
"steps": [
"User enters a valid name.",
"User enters a valid email that is not registered.",
"User enters a valid password.",
